title: Galen Corpus Infrastructure: Galen First Drafts, Census, Terminology Density Map and Lemmatizer Benchmarks
description:
Galen Corpus Infrastructure. Galen First Drafts: machine first-draft English translations of thirteen works of Galen with no complete English translation known to us (257,016 words of Greek), each with two independent renderings, the Greek, and pre-registered machine checks; each work's page names the earlier partial and other-language translations. A catalogue of 678 items found in the drafts (people, lost authors and books, recipes, cases, measures), with an attestation check against Fichtner's Corpus Galenicum and the fragment collections. The LSJ-Gold and LS-Gold lemmatizer benchmarks and the LSJ-Gold lexicon; a digital-availability census of the Galenic Greek corpus in First1KGreek (103 editions / 97 works) and a terminology density map.

The drafts are unverified and meant for reading and correction. Site: https://montblanctech.github.io/Galen/
